summary: Ultima Online entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Ultima Online
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Ultima Online live service with client/shard/publish state documented

emulation.notes: Use official client/service; private shards are separate historical/preservation routes.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official live shard or documented legacy ruleset shard

primary.version: Current official Classic or Enhanced Client live shard
primary.why: Ultima Online is a still-running MMORPG with Classic and Enhanced official clients, live shard updates, and free-to-play/subscription distinctions. The archive route must record client, shard, publish, account, era/ruleset, and character state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official client from uo.com. Record Classic vs Enhanced Client, publish/build, shard, account/subscription state, character template, expansion/access state, housing/guild/PvP scope, and whether any legacy shard or private preservation route was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting a particular historical ruleset.
secondary.why: Official live shards are the primary authority, but legacy ruleset preservation differs substantially.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record Classic vs Enhanced Client, publish/build, shard, account state, and era/ruleset scope.
